Class APRequestController

java.lang.Object
es.uji.ei1027.ei102725gbgs.controller.APRequestController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/APRequest") public class APRequestController extends Object
Controller class for managing APRequest entities. It provides endpoints for listing, adding, updating, and deleting APRequest entities, as well as specific endpoints for approving requests and listing requests by user.
